mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between inflation (CPIAUCSL) and monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) drives equity returns: when inflation rises above 3.5% and the federal funds rate is below 4.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return pattern fails in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates weakening economic activity, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In months with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, INDPRO decline below 100.0 does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising monthly housing starts (HOUST) above 1550.0 thousand units indicates strong demand for residential construction, which boosts related sectors and overall economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with HOUST growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 thousand units in a month, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when HOUST < 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) drives equity returns: when industrial production growth is negative and real GDP growth is below 1.0% annualized, it signals a weakening supply chain and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return pattern fails in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO decline > 1.0% from prior month), a sharp drop in industrial production signals manufacturing distress that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In months with INDPRO decline > 1.0% from prior month, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
